judgements.startNamesKeptTwice: Defect, recorded in failures with its red test. Reachable when a re-admission's start finds the root's architect running (a claim mid-launch when the linger's suspend ran, or the start before the suspend: outbox.go's own comment); the architect then gets the same decision in two messages, each saying `Read each before you continue`.
judgements.staleApprovalUnderGatesOff: Not failed. keepStaleApproval keeps an approval below the latest version whatever gates.design is, and ParkedDecisionTask names it only when gates.design is not off, so under off the row is never named or forgotten (at most one per root, replaced by a later keep, never deleted by a re-admission that finds nothing stale). A gate under off never holds an approval below its latest (a registration approves the registered version and no artifact event moves it), so the row exists only when a gate approved under root-issues was carried into an off re-admission. It can then surface only after the operator switches gates.design back on: the next start or relaunch catch-up says `approved at version N, now at version M` from that older generation, one stale sentence, while request-approval acts on the document's real latest version. It blocks nothing and needs two operator switches, so I do not fail the round on it; deleting the row in keepStaleApproval when nothing is stale, or keeping nothing under off, would close it.
